title: Developers
description: The API keys of your company, one for tests and one for real orders. Only the owner sees this page.
stale: The keys shown may be out of date.

test.title: Test key
test.description: For building and trying an integration: its orders stay apart from the real ones.

live.title: Live key
live.description: For an integration in production: its orders are real.

secret.title: Copy the key now
secret.description: It is shown only this once. If you lose it, replace the key.

replace.body: The current key stops working at once: any software that uses it needs the new one.

delete.body: The key stops working at once. You can create a new one at any time.

notices.replaced: Key replaced. The old one no longer works.
notices.deleted: Key deleted. It no longer works.
